brief: Cuts pieces out of a text: a section, a run, a character or an occurrence of a substring, returning each piece and removing it.
detail: Build one with new stzStringExtractor("text"). Every Extract verb answers the piece and takes it out of the text the extractor holds, which Content shows. Positions count from 1 and are in characters, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji are cut by letter. A section must have its start before its end: a reversed pair kills the process or removes nothing today. Extract(substr) returns the whole text before removal, not the part removed, and ExtractCharsW raises an error after removing; see their warnings. Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first extraction empties it.
receiver: o1 = new stzStringExtractor("hello world, hello moon")
